log.d: 6TH CS (6th Communications Squadron); Sq CC Lt Col Alt
A1C Jons (Family Crisis): Someone noticed what was going on at home. They won't forget it.
Ask A1C Jons about their hours awake before deciding what happened
WHEEL OF MEH (Foresight: not the Wheel of Failure)
MANDATORY FUN DAY · Party chose: Everyone goes.

MISSION FAILURE: The base network went down during a real-world alert. The recall never went out, and the wing missed its response window. Lt Col Alt fires 2d Lt Sim0: lowest CMD + Mission specialty bonus (+1); randomly selected among tied cadets. No votes, rolls, abilities, perks or upgrades for the rest of the game.
Brief the Wing CC on the failure and recovery plan
Correct A1C Jons's appearance quietly and set the standard
Ask SrA Hemauer what made the change urgent at 0200
RUMOR MILL · Party chose: Address it at roll call.
Sim0: Planning Cell; Sim1: Enlisted Council; Sim2: Golden Child; Sim3: Huddle
After reporting, counsel A1C Jons privately
Tell SSgt Donahoe you are adopting SrA Hemauer's idea now
Early Adopter: You adopted a subordinate's idea: 🎯+1, ⭐+1
CONTRACTOR FINISHES EARLY · Party chose: Move in now.
SrA Gross (Over-Achiever): Rested, they go back to delivering.
LT COL CACIC, THE INSPECTOR GENERAL (HP 26)
